title: IoT Execution Engineer
description:
Job Description – Industrial IoT Project Execution Engineer

**Company:** Ausweg Info Controls Private Limited  
**Job Locations:** Coimbatore, Chennai, and Bangalore  
**Employment Type:** Full-time | Field / Customer Site  
**Experience:** Freshers and candidates with 0–2 years of relevant experience can apply.

Role Overview

We are looking for enthusiastic candidates to support the installation, commissioning, and execution of Industrial IoT projects at customer sites.

The engineer will understand customer requirements, coordinate site activities, support hardware and software integration, and follow assigned projects through testing, customer training, and handover.

This role is suitable for candidates who enjoy practical engineering work, troubleshooting, customer interaction, and travelling to industrial sites.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Customer Requirements & Site Study**

* Visit customer factories to understand manufacturing processes and project requirements.
* Collect machine details, available signals, communication interfaces, installation requirements, and network information.
* Document customer requirements and clarify them with the internal project team.
* Check site readiness and identify customer support required before installation.

**2. Installation & Project Execution**

* Participate in the installation and commissioning of Industrial IoT solutions, including production monitoring, OEE, energy monitoring, and related applications.
* Support the installation and configuration of sensors, energy meters, gateways, industrial communication devices, and data acquisition systems.
* Coordinate with customer maintenance, electrical, production, and IT teams for wiring, connectivity, machine access, and installation activities.
* Follow approved drawings, project scope, execution plans, and site safety procedures.
* Perform electrical or machine-related work only with appropriate authorization and supervision.

**3. Connectivity, Configuration & Testing**

* Assist with connecting machines and devices to the IoT platform.
* Support device configuration, signal mapping, and communication checks under technical guidance.
* Verify collected data against actual machine operation or meter readings.
* Assist with software setup, machine and asset master configuration, dashboard checks, and user access setup.
* Troubleshoot basic device, communication, network, and data issues; escalate unresolved issues promptly.

**4. Project Ownership & Coordination**

* Take responsibility for assigned site activities and follow them through to completion.
* Track installation progress, pending tasks, customer dependencies, and technical issues.
* Share daily progress updates with the project manager or reporting engineer.
* Coordinate with internal hardware, software, and application teams to resolve issues.
* Record additional customer requests and obtain internal approval before making commitments outside the agreed scope.

**5. Customer Training & Handover**

* Demonstrate system operation and support customer training.
* Assist customers in understanding dashboards, data entry requirements, and basic troubleshooting.
* Prepare installation records, test reports, issue lists, and handover documents.
* Support customer acceptance testing and obtain completion confirmation through the approved process.
* Follow up on pending issues during the initial support period.

**6. Technical Support & Opportunity Identification**

* Provide basic technical support for deployed systems.
* Maintain clear records of reported issues and corrective actions.
* Identify additional customer requirements during site interactions and share them with the sales team.
* Support sales engineers with site surveys and technical information when required.

Educational Qualification

Candidates from the following backgrounds can apply:

* **Diploma:** Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Electronics & Instrumentation, Instrumentation & Control, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, or related disciplines.
* **B.E. / B.Tech:** EEE, ECE, Electronics & Instrumentation, Mechatronics, Computer Science, IT, or other relevant engineering specializations.
* **B.Sc.:** Computer Science, Electronics, Information Technology, or related technical disciplines.

**Relevant specialization, practical aptitude, and willingness to learn are more important than the qualification title alone.**

Required Skills & Attributes

* Basic understanding of electrical, electronics, or computer systems.
* Interest in Industrial IoT, manufacturing processes, and industrial automation.
* Ability to use a laptop for configuration, testing, documentation, and reporting.
* Basic troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to communicate clearly with customers and internal teams.
* Willingness to travel regularly and work at customer sites until assigned activities are completed.
* Responsible approach to project commitments, reporting, and site safety.
* Tamil and English communication skills for Tamil Nadu locations; Kannada is an advantage for Bangalore.

Added Advantages — Not Mandatory for Freshers

* Exposure to sensors, PLCs, energy meters, gateways, or industrial wiring.
* Basic knowledge of Ethernet, IP addressing, RS-485, or Modbus.
* Familiarity with IoT platforms, databases, SQL, or dashboards.
* Academic projects, internships, or practical training related to electronics, automation, or IoT.

Performance Expectations

* Timely completion of assigned site activities.
* Accurate data collection and validation.
* Clear daily reporting and timely escalation of issues.
* Proper installation, testing, and handover documentation.
* Effective customer coordination and training.
* Compliance with approved project scope and safety procedures.

**Freshers with strong technical interest, practical learning ability, and willingness to take responsibility at customer sites are encouraged to apply.**

Pay: ₹11,000.00 - ₹18,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: FTTH / Fiber Network Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an FTTH / Fiber Network Engineer to build, maintain and support our fiber-to-the-home network in Coimbatore. You will handle fiber installation, fault finding and GPON network upkeep, so that our customers get fast and reliable broadband.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, activate and test FTTH connections at customer premises (ONT/ONU setup, power level checks)
* Perform fiber splicing (fusion and mechanical) and terminate cables in joint closures, splitters and distribution boxes
* Test and troubleshoot fiber using OTDR, power meter and light source
* Identify and repair fiber cuts, high attenuation and signal loss
* Maintain and monitor GPON network components such as OLT, PON ports, splitters and ONTs
* Plan and supervise fiber laying (aerial and underground) with field teams
* Carry out preventive maintenance to reduce faults and downtime
* Resolve customer complaints on site and ensure SLA compliance
* Maintain records of fiber routes, splitter locations, materials and tickets
* Coordinate with the NOC team for network alarms and escalations

**Required Skills**

* Hands-on experience with fiber splicing, OTDR and optical power meter
* Good understanding of FTTH architecture, GPON and PON power budgets
* Knowledge of OLT and ONT configuration
* Basic networking knowledge (IP, VLAN, PPPoE, Wi-Fi router setup)
* Ability to read fiber route maps and work in field conditions
* Good troubleshooting and customer communication skills

**Qualifications**

* ITI / Diploma / B.E. / B.Sc. in ECE, EEE, Computer Science, IT or a related field
* Fiber splicing or OFC training certificate (preferred)
* CCNA or similar networking certification (a plus)

title: Network Engineer – ISP Operations
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Network Engineer – ISP Operations to manage, monitor and maintain our broadband and leased line network in Coimbatore. You will keep the network running with minimal downtime, resolve faults quickly, and support the field team and customers.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor the ISP network (core, aggregation and last-mile links) and respond to alarms and outages
* Troubleshoot connectivity issues on routers, switches, OLT/ONT and radio links
* Configure and maintain routers, Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, VLANs, and routing protocols
* Manage broadband customer activation, bandwidth profiles, and IP/PPPoE/RADIUS setup
* Coordinate with field teams for fiber faults, splicing, and new installations
* Perform preventive maintenance and network upgrades
* Track bandwidth utilization and raise capacity requests when needed
* Maintain network documentation, ticket logs and incident reports
* Escalate critical issues to senior engineers and vendors, and ensure SLA compliance

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, VLAN, OSPF, BGP, NAT and DHCP
* Understanding of FTTH/GPON, OLT/ONT and fiber networks
* Experience with network monitoring tools (Zabbix, PRTG, LibreNMS or similar)
* Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Basic knowledge of Linux and RADIUS/PPPoE servers

**Qualifications**

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech / B.Sc. in ECE, EEE, Computer Science, IT or a related field
* CCNA, MikroTik MTCNA or similar certification (preferred)

* Flexible schedule

* Life insurance

title: Environmental, Health, and Safety Specialist
description:
**Your role**
-------------

Bring your curiosity to work as our next **QSHE Engineer**. You will be part of our XXX team reporting to [Hiring manager title]. In this role, your mission is to [briefly describe the main mission in one clear sentence]. You will contribute directly to how we create high‑quality products and solutions for our customers.

Your Role As SHE Engineer (Safety, Health & Environment), your core mission is to ensure a safe, healthy, and environmentally sustainable workplace by driving compliance, risk management, and continuous improvement in SHE performance. You will implement and maintain SHE management systems, promote a strong safety culture, and support operational excellence across all functions. You will report directly to the SHEQ & Sustainability Manager.
  
  
Some things you will do in this role include:
  

* Safety Management & Compliance: Lead implementation and maintenance of safety management systems, ensuring compliance with applicable legal, corporate, and customer SHE requirements. Support compliance with ISO 45001, environmental regulations, and internal standards.
* Risk Assessment & Hazard Control: Conduct risk assessments, job safety analyses (JSA), HIRA studies, workplace inspections, and hazard identification activities. Ensure effective control measures are implemented and monitored.
* Incident Investigation & Corrective Actions: Lead investigations of incidents, near misses, unsafe conditions, and occupational health concerns using structured root cause analysis techniques. Drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to prevent recurrence.
* Environmental Management: Monitor environmental aspects and impacts, including waste management, emissions, energy consumption, water usage, and resource conservation. Support environmental compliance and sustainability initiatives.
* Health & Well-being Programs: Coordinate occupational health programs, medical surveillance, ergonomics assessments, and employee wellness initiatives to promote a healthy work environment.
* Training & Awareness: Develop and conduct SHE training programs, toolbox talks, emergency response drills, induction programs, and awareness campaigns to strengthen workforce engagement and safety culture.
* Emergency Preparedness & Response: Maintain emergency response plans and coordinate mock drills for fire, medical, chemical, and other emergency scenarios. Ensure readiness of emergency equipment and response teams.
* SHE Performance Monitoring: Monitor, analyze, and report SHE performance indicators, including incident rates, audit findings, safety observations, and environmental metrics. Drive continuous improvement actions based on performance trends.
* Audits & Management Systems: Plan and conduct SHE inspections and internal audits. Support external audits, customer audits, and certification activities related to ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 management systems.
* Sustainability & Continuous Improvement: Support sustainability initiatives, carbon footprint reduction projects, energy efficiency programs, waste reduction efforts, and ESG-related activities aligned with organizational objectives.

**Your day-to-day**
-------------------

* Lead implementation and maintenance of safety management system
* Conduct risk assesment
* Drive corrective and preventive action to prevent recurrences
* Plan and conduct SHE internal audits
* MIS reporting regarding Safety, Health and Environment
* Develop and conduct SHE, Trainings and awarness

**Your skills and experience**
------------------------------

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Environmental, Chemical, or related discipline).
* 3–6 years of experience in Safety, Health & Environment functions within manufacturing or industrial organizations.
* Strong knowledge of ISO 45001, ISO 14001, legal compliance requirements, and SHE management systems.
* Experience in risk assessment methodologies such as HIRA, JSA, FMEA, and incident investigation techniques.
* Knowledge of statutory regulations related to occupational health, safety, and environmental management.
* Experience in conducting SHE audits, inspections, emergency drills, and training programs.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and SHE reporting tools.

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. We value diverse experiences and perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the role.

**Your compensation and benefits**
----------------------------------

We offer compensation that reflects the skills, experience, and responsibilities of the role. Pay also depends on the country where the job role is based, as compensation practices vary across our markets. During the recruitment process, we share clear information about the pay and benefits for your location, so you know what to expect before moving forward.

**Your location**
-----------------

This role requires you to work on-site at our office in Coimbatore, India (IN). You will be part of a dynamic team and enjoy the benefits of face-to-face collaboration.

**Why it is great to work with us**
-----------------------------------

Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We focus on long‑term development and encourage you to explore new ideas that help us move forward. Innovation is part of how we think and act – we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. You can make a meaningful impact by contributing with your insights and taking ownership of your work, supported by flexible ways of working and leaders who empower you.

**Application process**
-----------------------

Our selection process includes interviews and, for some roles, skills assessments that help us gain a deeper understanding of your profile. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us. If you have questions during the process or need support, please contact us:

Talent Acquisition: Sathiyendran N, sathiyendran.n@tridentpneumatics.com

title: Research Associate Trainee – Computer Science
description:
**Research Associate Trainee – Computer Science**

**Location:** Gandhipuram, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu

**Work Mode:** Full-Time | In-Office Only

**Salary**

**Training Period:** ₹10,000 per month

**After Confirmation:** ₹15,000 per month

**About the Role**

We are looking for enthusiastic **Research Associate Trainees** who are interested in building a career in academic research, technical writing, and Computer Science research.

This is a structured training role where you will learn how research papers, literature reviews, technical reports, and thesis documents are prepared for international journals and conferences.

You will work under the guidance of experienced researchers and gradually take ownership of research support activities as your skills develop.

**Research Domains**

You will gain exposure to projects in one or more of the following areas:

* Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
* Data Science & Analytics
* Computer Vision & Image Processing
* Cybersecurity
* Computer Networks
* Internet of Things (IoT)
* General Computer Science Research

**Training & Responsibilities**

During your training period, you will learn to:

* Search and analyze recent research papers
* Conduct literature reviews and summarize research findings
* Organize references and citations using IEEE and other academic formats
* Format research papers, theses, and technical documents
* Prepare comparison tables and research summaries
* Assist in manuscript preparation and documentation
* Support senior researchers with publication-related activities
* Improve technical writing and academic English
* Learn the research publication process from idea to submission

Responsibilities will gradually increase based on your learning progress and performance.

**A Typical Day in This Role**

You may spend your day:

* Reading and summarizing research papers
* Preparing literature review tables
* Formatting research manuscripts
* Organizing references and citations
* Assisting with technical documentation
* Supporting senior researchers in ongoing projects

**Education**

* B.E. / B.Tech (Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics & Communication, or related disciplines)

**Experience**

* Freshers are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with up to 1 year of experience in research writing, technical writing, thesis documentation, or academic projects may also apply.

**Preferred Skills**

* Good written and reading skills in English
* Basic understanding of Computer Science concepts
* Strong analytical and logical thinking
* Attention to detail
* Good knowledge of Microsoft Word
* Interest in research and technical documentation
* Willingness to learn new concepts and work in a research-oriented environment

**Why Join Us?**

* Hands-on training in academic research and technical writing
* Exposure to real-world AI and Computer Science research projects
* Structured mentorship from experienced researchers
* Opportunity to contribute to research publications
* Collaborative and learning-focused work environment
* Long-term career growth opportunities

**Career Path**

Research Associate Trainee

↓

Research Associate

↓

Technical Research Engineer

↓

Senior Technical Research Engineer

↓

Research Team Lead

**Selection Process**

**Round 1:** Technical & English Writing Assessment

**Round 2:** Face-to-Face Interview (Mandatory)

**Important Hiring Policy**

* This is a full-time, in-office position based in Gandhipuram, Coimbatore.
* Candidates should be comfortable commuting or relocating before joining.
* Timely communication throughout the recruitment process is expected.
* Candidates who miss interviews without prior notice or repeatedly fail to respond to communication may not be considered for future openings.
* Please apply only if you are genuinely interested in attending the interview and joining if selected.
* Selected candidates must work a minimum of 1 year.

**How to Apply**

**Apply here in Indeed or Email your resume to:**

**softscholarshrd@gmail.com**

title: IT Infrastructure System Engineer - Windows
description:
**Company Description**

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins believes it is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.

In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 62,000 staff across a network of more than 1000 independent companies in over 62 countries and operating more than 900 laboratories. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.

In 2022, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 6.515 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

 **Job Description**

Position Title: L3 Operations Senior Compute Engineer  
Reporting To: Compute Service Operations Lead, Environment Testing Europe  
Working Location: Coimbatore  
Shift Timing: 12PM – 9PM IST  
  
  
OVERALL OBJECTIVES:

As part of the IT Infrastructure Support Team for Eurofins Environment Testing Europe, you will join a growing international team to work on maintenance of newly deployed segregated IT User Zones and Application Availability Groups Cloud infrastructure. Your role will be to support daily Compute operations tasks in a complex hybrid environment in Azure Cloud and local HyperV infrastructure. You will collaborate with number of different IT Support and Delivery Teams on daily basis. It will require strong Azure & HyperV virtualization, AD, Security and Networking skills. Open mind and ability to cooperate with multiple individuals in a multicultural environment is essential.  
  
You will get an opportunity to drive Eurofins major IT Infrastructure transition and transformation across Environment Testing Europe Businesses.  
  
SPECIFIC ASSIGNMENTS:  
  
  
Manage, maintain and optimize Azure compute services as well as on-premises Hyper-V clusters and virtual machine infrastructure  
Implement automation and orchestration for deployment, scaling, and management using PowerShell  
Monitor compute infrastructure health, troubleshoot incidents, and execute root cause analysis to prevent recurrence  
Collaborate with cloud architects, network, and security teams, as well as application owners at the international corporate level to support compute capacity planning and optimization and best meet business requirements in terms of security, cost, and effectiveness  
Enforce security best practices and compliance requirements in cloud and on-prem environments  
Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code for both Azure and Hyper-V platforms  
Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and knowledge sharing within the compute operations team  
Maintain detailed documentation of operational procedures, configurations, and workflows  
Stay current with environment version updates, emerging technologies, and industry best practices  
  
  
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:  
  
An ideal candidate should have strong experience in all of the below:  
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).  
5+ years managing compute infrastructure with strong focus on Microsoft technologies.  
Deep expertise in managing Hyper-V environments including failover clustering, live migration, and storage management.  
Solid understanding of Windows Server administration and networking fundamentals.  
Experience in administering and maintaining print server environments, as well as troubleshooting printing‑related issues in Windows environments.  
Experience with backup and disaster recovery strategies for both cloud and on-premises environments (preferably in Veeam backup environments).  
Excellent troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills  
Ability to read, understand and create technical documentation  
Very good command of English written and spoken  
Ability to present technical projects on meetings  
Proven experience with Microsoft Azure compute services  
Scripting skills in PowerShell; experience with Azure CLI and ARM templates is highly preferred.  
  
WOULD BE AN ADVANTAGE  
  
Experience in administering Linux server environments  
Accustomed to using ITSM tools (e.g. BMC Helix)  
Experience of monitoring tools (Site24x7, Grafana, etc.)  
Familiarity with Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and other Azure-native monitoring tools  
Experience with Azure DevOps or other CI/CD pipelines

title: Civil 3D Utility
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – CIVIL 3D DESIGNER (UTILITY SERVICES)

**Company:** JSE Engineering Pvt. Ltd.  
**Experience:** 2+ Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Work Mode:** On-site  
**Job Locations:** Chennai / Coimbatore / Trichy / Tirunelveli / Vizag

About JSE Engineering Pvt. Ltd.

Established in 2005 and headquartered in Chennai, JSE Engineering Pvt. Ltd. provides engineering design, BIM modeling, and technical solutions for global construction and infrastructure projects.

Job Summary

JSE Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a skilled **Civil 3D Designer – Utility Services** with 2+ years of experience in civil infrastructure design and utility modeling. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Autodesk Civil 3D, utility layouts, and infrastructure modeling, including wet and dry utilities.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain 2D and 3D civil infrastructure models using Autodesk Civil 3D.
* Prepare utility layouts, profiles, sections, and detailed design drawings.
* Model and coordinate wet utilities, including water supply, stormwater drainage, and sewerage networks.
* Work on dry utility layouts involving electrical networks, telecom, fiber-optic, and underground service corridors.
* Perform surface modeling, grading, corridor modeling, and alignment design as required.
* Create and modify Civil 3D assemblies, subassemblies, and pipe networks.
* Coordinate utility routes with road designs, other infrastructure elements, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Identify and resolve design clashes and utility routing conflicts.
* Prepare drawings and documentation in accordance with project specifications and applicable standards.
* Incorporate design revisions and coordinate with project engineers to meet project deadlines.

About JSE Engineering Pvt. Ltd.

JSE Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is an engineering consultancy specializing in multidisciplinary engineering design, MEP services, Building Information Modelling (BIM), drafting, and 3D modelling. title: VP - Platform
description:
**About Ginesys**

Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1,200+ customers and 50,000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite — ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys.AI.

**Role Summary**

The VP Platform runs the current infrastructure while building the target platform. This is an operating role and a transformation role.

The role keeps existing SaaS environments stable, builds the new cloud-native platform, owns the Oracle to Postgres migration pipeline, establishes the security practice, and brings platform engineering discipline into the way teams ship.

**What This Role Owns**

* Current SaaS infrastructure stability.
* Target cloud-native platform architecture and operations.
* Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, Redis, Kong, observability, and CI/CD platform foundations.
* Oracle to Postgres migration tooling, validation, rollback, and cutover support.
* Platform SLOs, incident response, on-call model, and environment controls.
* Security, network, access, secrets, WAF, and compliance readiness.
* DBA practice across Oracle legacy operations and PostgreSQL target operations.
* Platform team structure, hiring, standards, and capability building.

**What This Role Does Not Own**

* Product roadmap or commercial prioritization.
* Domain business rules owned by Supply Chain, Core Commerce, or Digital Commerce.
* Architecture authority for bounded contexts, which sits with the Chief Architect and Technical Design Council.
* Program status governance, which sits with the Transformation Program Lead.
* Embedded engineering delivery inside domain squads.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Operations**

* Own infrastructure across current and target environments.
* Define and operate platform SLOs.
* Manage environment provisioning, access, capacity, and decommissioning.
* Reduce cloud waste through shared infrastructure, capacity discipline, and retention controls.

**Target Platform**

* Build the shared platform foundation for Kubernetes, Postgres, Kafka, Redis, Kong, observability, and CI/CD.
* Establish standards for deployments, secrets, networking, monitoring, tracing, and release automation.
* Make platform capabilities usable by domain teams without each team having to invent its own tooling.

**Migration Engineering**

* Own the Oracle to Postgres migration pipeline with the migration engineering team.
* Define migration throughput, data validation, rollback readiness, and post-migration checks.
* Work with domain teams and Principal QA on parity, shadow, pilot, and cutover readiness.

**Security And Reliability**

* Build the security practice and baseline controls.
* Establish incident response, on-call, alerting, and production review practices.
* Drive SOC2 / ISO 27001 readiness where needed.

**Team Building**

* Lead a distributed platform organization across infrastructure, DBA, security, DevOps/SRE, internal IT, and migration engineering.
* Hire senior platform, security, SRE, and DevOps talent where the current team has gaps.
* Grow junior engineers into a disciplined platform practice.

**Required Experience**

* 15+ years in infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, database operations, or cloud operations.
* Experience leading teams of meaningful size and mixed seniority.
* Deep experience in at least two of Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS, Kafka, observability, or security operations.
* Experience running production systems while modernizing them.
* Strong understanding of multi-tenant SaaS operations, access control, reliability, and incident management.
Hands-on comfort with infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD tooling.  

  

**Helpful Experience**

* Oracle to Postgres migration experience.
* Retail, ERP, POS, OMS, or e-commerce platform experience.
* Experience building a platform team from an early stage.
* Familiarity with .NET, Java/Spring Boot, and mixed-stack modernization.
* Compliance exposure, including ISO 27001, SOC2, penetration testing, or security audits.

**Benefits**:

We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as:

Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development

Comprehensive health insurance coverage

Excellent rewards and recognition policy

Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC

Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year

Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country.

Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events

Quarterly Coffee with CEO and more!

**Here’s our story; now tell us yours**

“Ginesys One” is India’s best omni retail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite.

We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Coimbatore & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite.

Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. We are an ISO-certified and SOC compliant company having won myriad awards for our innovation and support. For further information, please visit our website http://ginesys.in
